key_insight: A large, spin-polarized database reveals that halide double perovskites have highly tunable electronic and magnetic properties, including many visible-gap and half-metallic candidates.
engineering_relevance: This dataset accelerates materials screening for solar, photocatalytic, radiation-detection, and spintronic devices by enabling composition-driven selection of promising double perovskites.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT DOS for >2,500 Cs2BB'X6 compounds
UMAP visualizations plus an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The study reports a database of >2,500 predicted-stable compounds, with 719 visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metallic materials.
watch_item: The results are computational predictions based on stability screening, so experimental validation is still needed before device deployment.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
